basis: Record of the independent review already communicated to /root; this recording step only reads digests and the frozen manifest, and does not repeat the source review.

findings.detail: ChildLiveness::Terminal is returned only when try_wait on the same locked original Child produces Some(status). try_wait I/O errors and process identity errors remain errors; startup verify_live preserves the original terminal error.

ActiveMaster exists before the awaited liveness check. Terminal drops that guard exactly once, then drops the host and global permits before entering existing generation-checked single-flight renewal. Error propagation releases the same values by RAII.

Existing admission profile, cancellation and deadline checks precede liveness as before. On the Live path, root, socket, peer, captured-command and response-authority code is unchanged. The terminal path uses existing renewal checks and repeats admission checks before any slave creation.
The renewal loop is entirely before captured(). Generic liveness, identity, socket, peer or post-submission errors do not trigger command replay.

renew-terminal starts with accepting=true, a reaped original Child, no maintenance pass, and 60 seconds of remaining master lifetime covering the 15-second request deadline. Its sentinel active count prevents new-master creation while assertions check one new generation, the original host semaphore, released global capacity, cancellation completion and existing cleanup.

limitations: Static review does not establish compilation, formatting, Clippy, libtest or six-host lifecycle acceptance; those gates are owned by the root agent.

The change covers terminal original masters already observable before slave submission. A master can still exit after a successful liveness check; the review does not claim arbitrary transport failures recover automatically.
The synthetic regression fixture checks admission renewal and cancellation before a new master connects. Real six-host failure recovery remains a separate execution gate.
This record does not adopt R23 or R24 and does not override the original R23 cancel-recovery failure.

reviewed: Typed original-child liveness and unchanged strict startup wrapper
Pre-slave admission renewal, active ownership and host/global capacity release
Cancellation, deadline, profile and error ordering
No replay after captured command submission
Renew-terminal regression fixture and its bounded cleanup assertions
